explanation: Missionaries in the 1600s developed Vietnamese's Latin-based script, which uses accent marks for its tones. Thai, Khmer and Lao scripts descend instead from the ancient Brahmi script of India.

claims.text: Of Vietnamese, Thai, Khmer and Lao, only Vietnamese is normally written in the Latin alphabet.
Thai, Khmer and Lao are written in their own scripts, not the Latin alphabet.
Vietnamese's Latin-based script was developed by Catholic missionaries in the 17th century.
The Vietnamese script uses diacritics to mark tones.
The Thai, Khmer and Lao scripts descend from the Brahmi script of ancient India.

writerNotes: Most players expect a Southeast Asian script for all four, so counterintuitive is true. The key is an only claim over the four options, a superlative in disguise, hence high.
